title: Claude Artifacts Just Got a Huge Upgrade
brief:

Verify its names, numbers, dates and claims from other credible sources, and find the exact figures.

So that little tracker or dashboard that you or your team use, Claude can now build that right on your desktop. So in this video, I’m going to show you how these new apps work, the other big upgrades that make artifacts one of the most important Cloud features to be getting good at right now and the real risk of getting locked into Claude’s ecosystem. So let’s get right into it. So the way this works is you actually build an artifact just like normal. And then when you open it up inside of the claw desktop app, you just go to share or you click on the name of the artifact and then you can hit install as app and then it gets its own icon and it opens up in its own window like any other app on your actual laptop or desktop. So, basically, it’s a page that Claude builds that lives at a live public link. And right now, there are seven templates.
